title: Community Cloud configuration
description: Everything the installer does comes from this file. See installer/README.md#configuration.

$schema.description: Where this schema is, for an editor to check the file against.

nodes.description: The machines in the cluster. The only required section.

token.description: The cluster token. The server and every agent need the same one. Required.

version.description: Pin the K3s release. Otherwise the current stable one.

channel.description: Pin the K3s release channel. Otherwise stable.

clusterCidr.description: The pod network. Defaults to 10.42.0.0/16, and wants to agree with the Cilium values.

disable.description: Packaged components to leave out, e.g. metrics-server. traefik, servicelb and local-storage are always left out.

extraServerArgs.description: Anything else to pass to the K3s server.

extraAgentArgs.description: Anything else to pass to K3s agents.

kubeconfig.description: Where kubectl should look, for a cluster this didn't build. Defaults to /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml.

congestionControl.description: TCP congestion control. Defaults to bbr.

qdisc.description: The default queueing discipline. Defaults to fq, which BBR wants underneath it.

congestionModule.description: The kernel module providing the algorithm, when it isn't tcp_<algorithm>.

cliVersion.description: The Cilium CLI release. "stable" takes whatever is current instead.

gatewayApiVersion.description: The Gateway API release. Pinned deliberately: a mismatched pair fails quietly.

kubeProxyReplacement.description: Whether Cilium takes over from kube-proxy. Defaults to true. K3s reads this too.

gateway.description: How the outside world reaches the cluster.

mode.description: floating: the address is already on a gateway node's interface. port-forward: a router maps ports to a LAN address nothing holds, and Cilium answers ARP for it.

interfaces.description: port-forward only. Which interfaces to answer ARP on, as regular expressions. Defaults to every local interface.

name.description: What to call the pool and policy. Defaults to community-cloud-gateway.

externalIPs.description: Addresses a particular node holds, as node name to address. The node must be a gateway.

nebula.description: A Defined Networking mesh, for nodes that can't reach each other directly.

apiKey.description: A Defined Networking API key. Falls back to the DEFINED_API_KEY environment variable.

id.description: Not a setting: the network's ID goes in networkID. Preflight says what's used instead.

roles.description: Roles to create on the network.

allowedRole.description: The role allowed in, by name.

packages.description: Which Helm charts to install. true is shorthand for enabled.

description.deprecationMessage: isn't a package, and is ignored. It can be taken out.

repo.description: For a package that isn't in the catalogue.

chart.description: For a package that isn't in the catalogue.

sha256.description: The fingerprint approved for it. Leave it out to be shown what the plugin adds and given the line to paste.

registries.description: Credentials for private registries, keyed by hostname.

auth.description: username and password, or one of the encoded forms.

endpoint.description: Where to actually fetch from, for mirroring.

rewrite.description: Regular expression rewrites applied to the image path.

values.description: What the manifests under k8s/ render against, as .Values.<path>. Open: plugins and your own manifests can read anything put here.

domain.description: The hostname each application is served on.

billingApi.description: Lago's API, which its web app and anything billing through it call.

plane.description: Plane, its web app, admin pages and API on the one hostname.

storage.description: SeaweedFS's S3, for the links applications give browsers to the files in their buckets.

storageControllerReplicas.description: How many TopoLVM controllers to run. Defaults to the number of storage nodes, since a replica with no node to go to never schedules.

k8sApiServer.description: Derived from the control-plane node; set it only to override.

l2Announcements.description: Derived from the gateway mode; set it only to override.

networkDevices.description: Derived from the shared interface list; set it only to override.

clusterAdminGroup.description: The Authentik group whose members are cluster admins when signed in through Headlamp. Defaults to "authentik Admins".

config.deprecationMessage: isn't read by the installer, and manifests only see it as .Values.config. Move what's in it under "values" — values.adminEmail, for instance.

domains.deprecationMessage: is the older place for hostnames, and manifests don't read it. Move them under "values.domain".

smtp.description: The mail servers applications send through, and which namespaces may send at all.

namespaces.description: The namespaces that may send mail, by name, each with credentials of its own.

dns.description: Publishes the hostnames applications are routed on, through ExternalDNS.

target.description: What records point at. Needed behind a router forwarding ports.

name.description: Names the instances and their credentials. Lower case letters, digits and hyphens.

provider.description: An ExternalDNS provider: cloudflare, aws, google, digitalocean, rfc2136 and so on.

domains.description: The domains its instances may write. A record outside them is never touched.

excludeDomains.description: Parts of those domains that belong to someone else.

namespaces.description: Whose routes it reads. One instance runs for each.

credentials.description: Environment variables, named as the provider's ExternalDNS documentation names them.

target.description: In place of dns.target, for this provider.

policy.description: sync (the default) removes a record when its route goes; upsert-only never removes anything.

pipelines.description: Named sequences of bundles, for run-pipeline.

version.description: Pin the Helm release, e.g. v3.16.3.

name.description: What to call it. Also how it registers in the cluster, when it can be a DNS label.

displayName.description: What to print it as, when that isn't its name.

address.description: How to reach it over SSH. Often an alias from ~/.ssh/config.

sshHost.deprecationMessage: is an older name for "address", and nothing connects through it. Use "address".

type.description: Exactly one node should be a server.

username.description: The SSH user. Needs passwordless sudo to root, without requiretty.

keyFile.description: A private key path. Otherwise the usual ~/.ssh keys and your agent are tried.

apiAddress.description: Where other nodes reach this one's Kubernetes API, when that differs from address.

nodeName.description: What to register as in the cluster, when name and address can't be DNS labels.

nodeIp.description: The address it registers on, which every other node reaches its pods through. Defaults to its address on the Nebula mesh when the cluster uses one, otherwise K3s's choice: the address of its default route.

nodeExternalIp.description: The address it's reached at from outside the cluster, such as a gateway's public address, when that isn't one K3s can tell is the outside.

gateway.description: true if the outside world can reach this node.

roles.description: What it's for, applied as node-role.kubernetes.io/<role> labels.

labels.description: Anything else worth labelling it with, as key/value pairs. A list here is the older shape for roles.

region.description: Where it physically is. Codes are fixed: see src/topology/regions.ts.

zone.description: A single physical location within the region, e.g. eur-de-1.

listenPort.description: Required for a lighthouse or a relay, and picked automatically otherwise.

staticAddresses.description: How other hosts reach this one, as host:port. Required for a lighthouse.

storage.description: Which disks TopoLVM may carve volumes out of. Per node, it overrides the cluster-wide section.

clusterStorage.description: Which disks TopoLVM may carve volumes out of, on every node, and how much each service claims from them.

allocations.description: How much local disk each service claims, in whole GiB. They share the same volume groups, so together they have to fit on the storage nodes. A size can be raised later; it can't be lowered.

databaseGb.description: The shared Postgres cluster, cc-postgres. Defaults to 30.

storageDisks.description: Consider only these, by path. Narrows what's considered; never overrides a safety check.

storageDiskClasses.description: Put a disk in a class other than the one its hardware suggests, by path.

storageMinimumSizeGb.description: Ignore disks smaller than this. Defaults to 1.

fromDomain.description: The domain mail is sent from. Defaults to values.domain.main.

username.description: Each namespace's own. Preflight refuses credentials in defaults.

password.description: Each namespace's own. Leave both out for a relay that takes mail without them.

mailSecurity.description: starttls (587), tls (465) or none (25). Defaults to starttls.

mailPort.description: Defaults to the usual port for security.
